correctness.rationale: From the actual RESULT.md definitions, the once-subdivided Q3 has 20 vertices, 24 edges and the valid three-point cubical configuration chain model C0..C3=(1140,3672,3840,1296). Independent finite reconstruction checks all chain face incidences and ranks mod 2 (1139,2527,1296), enumerates 1296 genuine free 3/2 elementary collapses, and computes the signed Lefschetz traces for every one of 48 cube automorphisms; the resulting ten class values are (17,-1),(-3,3),(1,-1),(-1,-1),(1,-1) in the stated S4 class order, exactly the claimed irreducible character. The integral H1=Z^6 premise is supplied by Ko–Park for simple 3-connected planar graphs with one planar exchange class; mod-prime ranks are corroboration, not an invalid assertion that they alone determine Z-homology. With H3=0 and Euler characteristic 12, H2 is free rank 17. The equivariant subdivision theorem underwrites equality with the continuous graph configuration space. Scope excludes integral Z[G] lattice classification.
